Choose a crop input rate from an upstream yield manifest

Source: R/manifest-tail.R
decide_rate_from_manifest.Rd

The agronomic manifest tail. Where decide_input_rate() takes a yield-draws matrix assembled by the caller, decide_rate_from_manifest() sources that matrix – and the grounding token – directly from an orchestra_manifest emitted upstream (a PESTO inversion or a mechanistic yield-response posterior). It is the formalised crop-pipeline tail: a yield posterior in, a profit-optimal, grounding-aware nitrogen-rate decision out. The grounding rides from the producer, so an un-grounded yield posterior forces the status-quo rate.

Usage

decide_rate_from_manifest(
  manifest,
  rates,
  price_grain,
  price_input,
  safe_rate = 0,
  decisive_prob = 0.6,
  ...
)

Arguments

manifest

An orchestra_manifest carrying a yield-per-rate draws matrix (in outputs or metadata$yield_draws), one column per rate.

rates

A numeric vector of candidate input rates, one per column of the manifest's draws matrix.

price_grain

Grain price per unit yield.

price_input

Input price per unit rate.

safe_rate

The fallback rate on abstention (default 0, the no-input status quo).

decisive_prob

Minimum posterior probability that the leading rate is best (see decide()).

...

Further arguments passed to the decision core (e.g. min_ess).

Value

A decision object whose action is the chosen rate.

See also

decide_from_manifest() for the generic tail; decide_input_rate() for the caller-assembled-matrix form.

Other manifest: decide_from_manifest()

Examples

set.seed(1L)
rates <- seq(0, 200, by = 25)
demo_manifest <- S7::new_class(
  "demo_manifest",
  properties = list(
    outputs         = S7::new_property(S7::class_any, default = NULL),
    metadata        = S7::new_property(S7::class_list, default = list()),
    summary         = S7::new_property(S7::class_any, default = NULL),
    run_id          = S7::new_property(S7::class_character, default = ""),
    emitter_package = S7::new_property(S7::class_character, default = "")
  )
)
ymax  <- rnorm(1500L, 5.5, 0.3)
yld   <- vapply(rates,
                function(r) 3 + (ymax - 3) * (1 - exp(-r / 80)),
                numeric(1500L))
m <- demo_manifest(
  metadata = list(yield_draws = yld, grounding = grounding_grounded())
)
decide_rate_from_manifest(m, rates, price_grain = 300, price_input = 1.2)
#> <decision> decided  [grounded]
#>   action : 175
#>   E[utility]: 1355
#>   candidates: 9 evaluated (method: expected_profit)
